categories.name: rpc
categories.evidence: Touches `src/bitcoin-cli.cpp` argument handling and help text for `-rpcclienttimeout=0`.
categories.rationale: Clarifies `bitcoin-cli` documentation and aligns implementation for `-rpcclienttimeout=0` with the actual socket wait cap. It replaces an arbitrary 5-year placeholder with `Sock::MAX_WAIT_TIMEOUT` and notes that 0 selects the maximum supported timeout (~24 days).

categories.name: utils
categories.evidence: Touches `src/util/sock.h` and `src/util/sock.cpp` to introduce a named timeout constant and Doxygen documentation.
categories.rationale: Names a magic timeout calculation in `util/sock` and documents the cap in Doxygen comments. This addresses review follow-ups from #36340 without changing core socket wait behavior.
